description.$value: Button state colors, high emphasis branch, dark mode: rest, hover and active for primary, secondary and the border of secondary. Tertiary reuses secondary. Hover and active are made with color modifiers (mix, alpha). Each color has an inversion pair: the plain name for the dark surfaces, the name with _inverse for inverted surfaces (it holds the light mode colors).
